_comment: The harness size budget (Round 3 / W7, ADR-H288). The TOTAL is the binding constraint; the per-module ratchet lives in python/tests/test_size_budget.py. Raising a ceiling is allowed but must be a deliberate edit to this file - the point is that growth cannot happen silently. Raised deliberately for the data-integrity release (ADR-H327), then ratcheted DOWN for the V2 terminal merge (ADR-H311): the code profile now runs through the one TerminalManager and the removed direct sandbox path is gone.
